answer: Require each identity to carry a license, checked against the issuing board's register. To enroll, the agent submits a license number; the board confirms it is active and linked to no other identity. A duplicate freezes both identities and holds their earnings pending audit, while a forged license ends the identity and is reported to the board. Earning 10,000 real licenses means passing exams and paying about $800 each in fees, $8,000,000 in all. A license is an anchor no script can forge: its number must echo exactly in the board's register, and a quartz-hard check rejects any mismatch.
